# `array_size`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the size of an array. The function returns null for null input.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_size(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_size, example 1
> SELECT array_size(array('b', 'd', 'c', 'a'));
4
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
